stem: Which idea helps readers understand that the story “The Farm Where Nothing Grew” is a folktale?

options.label: A
options.text: The farmer has special skills that help him do his job.

options.label: B
options.text: The farmer tricks others into helping him complete a task.

options.label: C
options.text: The townspeople learn the lesson that what they think is true can change.

options.label: D
options.text: The townspeople believe they should all have different roles in the town.
